THE PROJECT

Ooredoo Excel Dashboard

An internal dashboard developed during my internship at Ooredoo Tunisia. It brings Excel uploads, dataset navigation, filtering and PDF reporting into one interface.

My contribution

I developed the React interface and Java/Spring Boot API. Apache POI reads the spreadsheet data, and the frontend turns filtered results into shareable PDF reports.

CONTEXT

Ooredoo Tunisia · June–August 2025

BUILT WITH

React · Java · Spring Boot · Apache POI
